test.name: French Republican date hands back to convert-dates
test.description: Tests that when a user asks what a French Republican calendar date means and when the child was actually born, the agent explains the Republican-calendar context (used in French civil records 1793–1805) and hands the conversion back to the convert-dates agent, without stating a converted Gregorian date itself — this agent has no conversion tool, so any date it gives would be from memory.

input.delegation: I have a French civil birth record for my ancestor dated "18 Brumaire an VIII". What does that date mean, and when was the child actually born?

judge_context: Must explain that the record is dated in the French Republican calendar, used in French civil records 1793–1805
Must name `convert-dates` for the Gregorian date
Must NOT state a converted Gregorian date itself (e.g. 9 November 1799) — this agent has no conversion tool, so any date it gives is from memory
